items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: From Lucky Millinder's band to Jimmy Johnson's band.

ctx.x: band... From Baron Lee's band to Lucky Millinder's band. From Lucky Millinder's band to Jimmy Johnson's band. Then back to Lucky Millinder's band, then to Benny Carter's band. When you get into Benny Carter's band... Benny Carter organized a band like every two years. You see, he'd sit down and he'd write six arrangements. Then he'd get a new band. So he'd rehearse his arrangements, see how his arrangements are. Then he'd get two or three books of bookings, then he'd break up the band. Then he takes all his…
Yeah, you see him around right now.
